newsitem.title: NORWAY: DnB says gets S&P A1 short-term rating.
newsitem.headline: DnB says gets S&P A1 short-term rating.

text.p: Den norske Bank (DnB), Norway's largest bank, said on Monday that Standard & Poor's had assigned it an A1 short-term rating and A in the long term.

"The short-term rating is on level with the best among the Nordic banks, while Den Danske Bank (DDB) and Svenska Handelsbanken are the only Nordic banks to have received a better long-term rating by Standard & Poor's than Den norske Bank," DnB said in a statement.
DnB said it already had a P1 short-term rating and an A2 long-term rating from Moody's.

"The combination A1/P1 in short-term ratings from Standard & Poor's and Moody's makes it possible for Den norske Bank to collect significant short-term funding from the American commercial paper market," the statement said.
It said DnB may establish a commercial paper programme in the United States with a framework of $3 billion.
